mapper.sql: id, from_id, to_id, conversation_id, content, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message ( from_id, to_id, conversation_id, content, status ) VALUES ( #{fromId}, #{toId}, #{conversationId}, #{content}, #{status} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM message WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT m.id, m.from_id, m.to_id, m.conversation_id, m.content, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at FROM message m INNER JOIN ( SELECT conversation_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM message WHERE from_id = #{userId} OR to_id = #{userId} GROUP BY conversation_id ) latest ON latest.max_id = m.id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
